images.title: A wall as high as two doors
images.purpose: Show estimating with a reference: a door of about 2 m beside a wall that is as high as 2 doors, so the wall is about 4 m.
images.composition: A wall on the right, a door in front of the left side, a second door outlined above the first, and brackets.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. GROUND: one thin grey #6B7280 horizontal line from x 128 to x 1328 at y 700. WALL: one rectangle 520 px wide and 560 px high (x 700 to 1220, y 140 to 700) filled pale grey #6B7280 at 20 percent. DOOR 1: one amber #E69F00 rectangle 140 px wide and 280 px high (x 420 to 560, y 420 to 700) with a small dark round handle 14 px across at x 540, y 570, standing on the ground in front of the left edge of the wall. DOOR 2: one dashed outline rectangle 140 by 280 px (x 420 to 560, y 140 to 420) in amber, stacked exactly on top of Door 1 and reaching the top of the wall. BRACKETS: one teal #0072B2 bracket left of Door 1 from y 420 to y 700 at x 360 with the label door about 2 m in 36 px at x 250, y 560; one reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket at the right of the wall from y 140 to y 700 at x 1270 with the label wall about 4 m in 40 px at x 1330, y 420. Across the bottom centre, y 770, one line of bold text 2 × 2 m = 4 m in 52 px. In all: 1 wall, 1 door, 1 dashed door, 2 brackets. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 2 doors, one solid and one dashed
images.takeaway: Count how many times a known reference fits, then multiply and say about.
images.description: A wall as high as two doors of about 2 m each, so about 4 m high.
images.context: Concept image for Estimating with a Reference. It follows the idea of the house and the electric pole pictures in your maths book (children and a ladder as references) and shows the concept's own example of a wall and a door (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Stack the second door on the first in the child's mind. The slip to watch: saying the exact height instead of about.

image_decisions.why: Show estimating with a reference: a door of about 2 m beside a wall that is as high as 2 doors, so the wall is about 4 m.
